entities.name: Antun Knežević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fra Antun Knežević was a Bosnian Franciscan friar, historian and writer from Varcar Vakuf, Bosnia and Herzegovina. He was a proponent of Bosnian national identity, while being an active member of the Illyrian Movement.
